title: Specify the read-only treasury swarm with a no-broadcast invariant
description: Write docs/spec/P21_ARCHITECTURE.md defining the read-only treasury allocation swarm: the allocator agent, the hold_file gate, the allocation-report generator, and the SINCOR dashboard publisher, with data flows between them. (1) The spec states the hard no-broadcast invariant as a blocking requirement: the swarm computes allocation reports and NEVER broadcasts transactions. (2) The report schema and both gates (hold_file, execute_live_env) are defined. (3) The execute_live_env approval path is documented: delegation to an approved external executor, swarm still never signs. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Define P21 Python interfaces and the allocation report schema
description: Define Python interfaces in src/sincor2/defi/p21/interfaces.py: TreasuryAllocator, AllocationReport, GateCheck protocols plus the dashboard publisher contract. (1) The interfaces are type-checked and a stub report validates against the schema. (2) The report dataclass covers per-venue allocations, risk metrics, fee_bps (8), and the canonical treasury 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac. (3) The schema enforces allocations summing to 100%. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P21 economics: 8 bps fee, 4% APR target, 0.30 max alloc
description: Write docs/spec/P21_ECONOMICS.md: 8 bps protocol fee on realized treasury yield routed to the canonical treasury, 4% target APR assumptions, risk_score 0.20 allocation bounds, max_alloc_pct 0.30 per venue per tick, min_capital_usd 1.0. (1) The numbers are specified so the fee-routing module can implement them to the wei. (2) A worked fee-math example per reallocation tick is included (e.g. $1M at 4% APR → $40k yield → $32 fee). (3) The rebalancing trigger table is complete (500 bps band deviation or 24h elapsed). Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Create the P21 Python package skeleton
description: Create src/sincor2/defi/p21/ with allocator.py, gates.py, report.py, publisher.py, fees.py, plus tests/pytest/test_p21_*.py stubs, configs/agents/p21-treasury-dao.yaml, and a docs runbook stub. (1) The package imports cleanly (python -m compileall passes). (2) The layout matches the repo's Python-agent conventions. (3) The YAML parses. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P21 allocator and report stubs with catalog defaults
description: Write starter boilerplate: an allocator stub with TOA hooks, a report generator stub emitting an empty-but-valid allocation report, and config defaults (fee_bps=8, target_apr=0.04, risk_score=0.20). (1) python -m compileall passes on the package. (2) The stub report validates against the report schema. (3) Defaults match the catalog ProtocolSpec exactly. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement the treasury allocator inside the risk budget
description: Build the allocator agent in src/sincor2/defi/p21/allocator.py: computes target allocations across yield venues within the risk budget (risk_score 0.20), max_alloc_pct 0.30 per venue, the four bands (stables 40–60%, blue-chip 20–35%, yield venues 10–25%, native 5–15%), and TOA revenue forecasts, with error handling, retries with backoff, and TOA ingest_feedback hooks. (1) Produces a valid allocation report for a mocked venue set. (2) Bands and the 0.30 per-venue cap are respected. (3) Invalid inputs raise instead of silently defaulting. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement the content-addressed hold_file gate
description: Implement the hold_file gate in src/sincor2/defi/p21/gates.py: every allocation decision (including no-action) is written to a content-addressed hold file (JSON, filename = sha256 of canonical contents) awaiting human review; no downstream step proceeds without a reviewed hold file. (1) Unreviewed holds block publishing in tests. (2) Reviewed holds unlock it. (3) Holds older than 72h unreviewed raise a backlog alert. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement the canonical allocation report generator
description: Implement the allocation report generator for the canonical treasury: per-venue allocations, risk metrics, fee projection at 8 bps, IPS-limit checks, runway projection, and a human-readable summary, written to the hold file and the dashboard feed. (1) Allocations sum to exactly 100% in every generated report. (2) Reports round-trip through the dashboard schema. (3) A no-action tick still emits a valid report. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement the BroadcastForbidden no-broadcast guard
description: Implement the no-broadcast guard: the swarm holds no signing capability and no signing libraries are importable from the allocator module; any code path attempting a transaction broadcast raises BroadcastForbidden and logs a security event. (1) Broadcast attempts through every agent entrypoint raise in tests. (2) The catalog live_blocked=False flag does not weaken this invariant. (3) An import-lint test fails if a signing library becomes importable from the allocator path. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement the SINCOR dashboard publisher
description: Implement the dashboard publisher posting reviewed allocation reports to the SINCOR dashboard feed on the status-feed schema, reporting unknown rather than healthy on failure. (1) A reviewed report publishes end-to-end. (2) A dashboard endpoint failure is surfaced, never swallowed. (3) Unreviewed holds are never published. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement 8 bps fee routing to the canonical treasury
description: Implement 8 bps fee computation on realized treasury yield, routed to the canonical treasury 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac with per-tick accounting. (1) Fee math matches the worked example in P21_ECONOMICS.md to the wei. (2) The treasury address constant is verified against the catalog at import time; a mismatch fails closed. (3) Zero-yield ticks route zero fee without error. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Implement the execute_live_env controller
description: Implement the execute_live_env controller: live execution of approved allocations happens ONLY when the EXECUTE_LIVE_ENV flag is set and a reviewed hold file exists, and execution is delegated to an approved external executor path (the swarm itself still never broadcasts). (1) Report-only behavior without the env flag, even against live data. (2) Reviewed-holds-only dispatch with the flag set. (3) Every dispatch is audit-logged. (4) The flag defaults to off in every deploy config. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P21 unit tests with 85% coverage of the package
description: Write unit tests under tests/pytest/test_p21_treasury_dao_unit.py covering gates, fee math, report schema validation, and the no-broadcast guard. (1) All tests pass. (2) Line coverage of src/sincor2/defi/p21/ is above 85%. (3) The import-lint test for signing libraries is included. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P21 pipeline integration tests
description: Write integration tests for the full pipeline: allocator to hold file to review to report to dashboard publish, plus the live-env controller with the env flag on and off. (1) The full pipeline is green. (2) Both flag states are tested. (3) The no-broadcast invariant holds in every path. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Fuzz P21 allocation invariants across 1000+ cases
description: Write property and invariant tests: allocations always sum to 100%, max_alloc_pct 0.30 is never exceeded, and no fuzzed allocator input ever produces a broadcast attempt. (1) Invariants hold over at least 1000 randomized cases. (2) Band limits hold on every case. (3) Zero broadcast attempts across all cases. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Run the P21 allocator on a Base fork with zero emitted transactions
description: Run the allocator against forked Base state with real venue data, verifying the report generator handles real balances and the live-env controller stays report-only without EXECUTE_LIVE_ENV. (1) The simulation produces a valid report from real venue data. (2) Zero on-chain transactions are emitted. (3) The no-broadcast alarm stays silent (any firing is a failure). Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Assemble the P21 audit-prep package
description: Assemble the audit-prep package: frozen code snapshot, a threat model focused on accidental broadcast, hold-file tampering, and fee diversion, plus a known-limitations log. (1) A single reviewable directory exists with the commit hash recorded. (2) The threat model covers the three named classes. (3) The known-limitations log is filed. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Remediate all P21 medium-and-higher audit findings
description: Remediate all audit findings rated medium or higher, re-running the full P21 suite and the no-broadcast guard tests after each fix. (1) Zero open medium-or-higher findings. (2) The full suite is green after each fix. (3) Each fix links to its regression test. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Gas-optimize P21 on-chain components with a 20% hot-path cut
description: Gas-optimize the on-chain components (fee routing, executor adapter): measure gas per path and target a 20% reduction on hot paths without changing behavior. (1) A committed before/after gas report shows the 20% cut on hot paths. (2) All tests still pass. (3) Behavior is unchanged (byte-identical outputs on the fixture set). Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write the P21 component reference
description: Write technical docs: a component reference for src/sincor2/defi/p21/, the report schema, gate semantics, and the no-broadcast invariant. (1) Docs build without warnings. (2) Every public function is documented. (3) Gate semantics (hold_file, execute_live_env) are specified exactly. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Ship the P21 agent YAML config and ops runbook
description: Ship configs/agents/p21-treasury-dao.yaml (budgets, memory, TOA hooks, check-in cadence) plus docs/ops/P21_RUNBOOK.md covering hold-file review, dashboard checks, and live-env enablement. (1) The YAML validates. (2) Runbook steps are executable by an operator (hold-file review, dashboard checks, live-env enablement). (3) The runbook states the 72h hold-review SLA. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Add P21 dashboard monitoring hooks
description: Add monitoring hooks: allocation-report freshness alert (fires if no reviewed report in 30h), hold-file backlog metric, and a no-broadcast-attempt alarm wired to the SINCOR dashboard. (1) Hooks emit on the feed schema. (2) Alerts fire on simulated staleness. (3) The no-broadcast alarm firing is classified SEV-1 in the runbook. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Write P21 testnet and agent deploy scripts
description: Write testnet deploy scripts for any P21 on-chain components plus the offchain agent deployment (Railway/Gunicorn) with EXECUTE_LIVE_ENV defaulting to off. (1) Scripts run end-to-end on Base Sepolia. (2) Agent check-ins are visible in logs. (3) A CI check asserts the flag default is off in every deploy config. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.

title: Produce the P21 mainnet readiness checklist
description: Produce the mainnet readiness checklist: audit sign-off, env-flag policy, treasury address verification (0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac), rollback plan, and a printed compliance checkpoint pre-flight. (1) The checklist is reviewed and signed with go/no-go recorded. (2) Rollback steps are executable. (3) No live-env enablement before sign-off. Ref: per specs/p21-treasury-dao.md §Acceptance criteria.
